sql: select * from (select 'incentive_book_events' t, date_trunc('week',received_at)::date wk, count(*)*50 est from incentive_book_events tablesample system(2) group by 1,2 union all select 'execution_book_events' t, date_trunc('week',received_at)::date wk, count(*)*50 est from execution_book_events tablesample system(2) group by 1,2 union all select 'incentive_market_snapshots' t, date_trunc('week',at)::date wk, count(*)*50 est from incentive_market_snapshots tablesample system(2) group by 1,2 union all select 'incentive_shadow_outcomes' t, date_trunc('week',ended_at)::date wk, count(*)*50 est from incentive_shadow_outcomes tablesample system(2) group by 1,2 union all select 'incentive_shadow_quotes' t, date_trunc('week',placed_at)::date wk, count(*)*50 est from incentive_shadow_quotes tablesample system(2) group by 1,2 union all select 'mmsell_position_ticks' t, date_trunc('week',captured_at)::date wk, count(*)*50 est from mmsell_position_ticks tablesample system(2) group by 1,2 union all select 'crypto_ladder_snapshots' t, date_trunc('week',captured_at)::date wk, count(*)*50 est from crypto_ladder_snapshots tablesample system(2) group by 1,2 union all select 'live_order_queue_ticks' t, date_trunc('week',captured_at)::date wk, count(*)*50 est from live_order_queue_ticks tablesample system(2) group by 1,2 union all select 'incentive_shadow_events' t, date_trunc('week',at)::date wk, count(*)*50 est from incentive_shadow_events tablesample system(2) group by 1,2) x order by 1,2
